patthana16.85:1.1: pītisahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anidassana appaṭigho na pītisahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, anidassana appaṭighaṃ pītisahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sanidassana sappaṭigho na pītisahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, …pe… anidassana appaṭighaṃ pītisahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sanidassana sappaṭigho na pītisahagato ca na anidassana sappaṭigho na pītisahagato ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā, hetuyā cha.
